The '''FOE-2000''' also known as the '''Fabrennix oxygen extractor''' was an [[oxygen extractor]] manufactured by [[Vercanne Mineral Technologies]]. It used a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long probe to extract [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from sub-surface water deposits and [[Water/Legends|water]] vapor.
